title: A letter from Bill Rivers after the New York news reached Miami
summary: Bill Rivers wrote inviting him to join Hartley Toots's band, a letter he never answered but keeps.

bands.name: Hartley Toots and his Orange Pickers

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And here it is, the people down there in Miami told me that I couldn't play, so what happened -- while I'm working at the Rosebud, the news gets back to Miami that I'm playing with a group -- only been in New York a week, and they hear I'm working. I get this long letter, which I still have in my scrapbook, from Bill Rivers.

Yeah -- and telling me that he had heard about what happened to me in New York and he would like me to join Hartley Toots band and they were getting ready to go on the road -- and you know, I didn't even answer that letter; I never did answer that letter. But I have it in my scrapbook because that is one of my fond memories of him breaking my heart that Sunday night.
